items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Man I was racing him and Mike here, and I was trying to get him to play the type of bass, you know what I mean?

ctx.x: Even Buddy. Of course Buddy don't date back with me. Buddy, because he's a latecomer. He's a latecomer. See, but Buddy's the same way. Man I was racing him and Mike here, and I was trying to get him to play the type of bass, you know what I mean? And he gets to play and he goes, that four, four beat, boom. Running all up and down the neck of the bass. Yeah, you see. Yeah.
Which is it. I think it looks good, but it doesn't get to be a band of the right support. No musician can't appreciate it.
